title: CASPA: Context-Aware Single-Cell Proteomics Analysis pipeline
description: Snakemake pipeline for label-free single-cell proteomics: adaptive quality control, entropy-guided iterative Harmony batch correction, multi-modality marker discovery and context-aware cell type annotation by large language models with a three-round prompt architecture and full audit trail. Software accompanying Salomó Coll, Makar et al., Nature Communications (2026).
